patterns: Direct founder questions dominate: Faraizi = Haji Shariatullah (Dudu Miyan = leader of rebellion), Deoband 1866 in UP, MAO College 1875, Wahabi centre Patna.
APPSC tilts to: Darul Uloom Deoband state (UP), Asbab-e-Baghawat author, Wahabi = anti-British, Kuka Ram Singh first to use boycott, Literary Society at Calcutta.
Book/journal -> author pairs recur (Tahzib-ul-Akhlaq, The Indian Musalmans = W.W. Hunter); Theodore Beck as MAO principal is a classic.
App adds AP-specific Wahabi angle (Mubariz-ud-Daula) and many multi-statement items; a few are opinion/significance items absent from PYQs.
